source: Kalshi trade tape, fees from Kalshi's fee schedule
feeMethod: per fill, with each series' terms in force on the trade date: taker = round up(0.07 x M x C x P x (1-P)), maker = round up(0.0175 x M x C x P x (1-P)) on maker-fee series (M = 2 on combo-maker series; round up(0.0025 x C) May 13 - Jul 7, 2025). Rounding: next cent on the fee before Jul 7, 2026; from then fee + positionCost to the centicent (point) or cent (upper bound). Lower bound: unrounded.

feeSchedules.source: Kalshi fee schedule, Perpetual Futures Fees, Tables 1-2 (effective Jul 7, 2026)
